0.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_CHAMBERLAIN00466_000_000
0.description: If you are here for the Valentione's event, I'm afraid the venue is overcrowded at present. We ask for your patience and understanding.

1.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_CHAMBERLAIN00466_000_010
1.description: Greetings and welcome, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>. If you wish to undertake the Valentione's Ceremony, I should be pleased to assist you.

2.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_Q1_000_000
2.description: What would you like to do?

6.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_YESNO_CONTENT
6.description: Proceed to the Valentione's Ceremony venue?

7.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_Q2_000_000
7.description: What would you like to ask?

10.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_A2_000_003
10.description: Tell me about the first trial.

11.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_A2_000_004
11.description: Tell me about the second trial.

13.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_CHAMBERLAIN00466_000_020
13.description: The Valentione's Ceremony is a series of light-hearted trials that measure the affinity between two souls. We should be pleased if the ceremony serves as your first step together on the journey of love.

14.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_021
14.description: The Valentione's Ceremony is an instance designed for a party of two. There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.

15.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_022
15.description: In the event that you register for the ceremony alone, your partner will be found via the matching system.

16.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_CHAMBERLAIN00466_000_030
16.description: The ceremony comprises two trials, which are collectively known as the Trials of the Moon. Overcoming them will require cooperation, communication, patience─such things as form the foundation of a strong relationship.

17.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_031
17.description: The Valentione's Ceremony is made up of two mini-games: “Till Mog Do Us Part” and “Cards Beat as One.”

18.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_032
18.description: Upon the completion of both, you will receive an affinity rating for your party.

19.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_CHAMBERLAIN00466_000_040
19.description: In the first trial, you and your partner must make your way through an obstacle-filled maze. Though you each will have your own path, you must avoid straying far from one another, lest your bond be broken.

20.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_041
20.description: In the trial “Till Mog Do Us Part,” you and your partner are joined by a magical chain.

21.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_042
21.description: Straying too far from one another will cause the chain to break, during which time the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Affinity<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> bar will slowly drain.

22.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_043
22.description: Being attacked by moogles will also drain the bar.

23.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_044
23.description: If the bar is completely drained, the duty will end in failure, and you will be ejected from the instance.

24.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_045
24.description: Completion time and remaining Affinity influence your final rating while determining your bonus for the second trial, “Cards Beat as One.”

25.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_CHAMBERLAIN00466_000_050
25.description: The second trial challenges your powers of recollection and reasoning, while calling on a bit of luck and cooperation for good measure.

26.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_051
26.description: The trial “Cards Beat as One” is a card-matching game. Twelve cards will be laid out, and couples must cooperate to turn over matching pairs.

27.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_052
27.description: If you guess incorrectly, you will be required to select again until all cards have been matched.

28.name: TEXT_FESVLT2018ENTRANCE_00466_SYSTEM_000_053
28.description: The number of incorrect guesses influences your final affinity rating.
